name: @pipeworx/mcp-gitignore

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all available .gitignore template names from github/gitignore.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Fetch the raw .gitignore content for the named template (case-sensitive, e.g. "Node", "Python", "macOS").

tools.name: compose
tools.description: Compose a combined .gitignore from multiple templates, separated by headers.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gitignore forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gitignore pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
